scholarships.name: Full tuition fee remission (family income below Rs 1 lakh)
scholarships.eligibility: General, OBC-NCL and EWS B.Tech/BS/Dual Degree students whose family income is under Rs 1 lakh a year; a valid income certificate has to be uploaded through the institute's SSP portal.
scholarships.benefit: The entire tuition fee (Rs 1,00,000 per semester in 2026-27) is waived; only the other institute charges remain, so a 2026 entrant pays Rs 41,402 in the first semester instead of Rs 1,41,402.

sources.title: Fees Circular for the New Students (UG & PG) of 2026 Batch — notes on tuition remission by family income

scholarships.name: Two-thirds tuition fee remission (family income Rs 1–5 lakh)
scholarships.eligibility: General, OBC-NCL and EWS undergraduate students with family income between Rs 1 lakh and Rs 5 lakh a year, supported by a valid income certificate.
scholarships.benefit: Two-thirds of tuition is remitted, leaving about Rs 33,333 of tuition per semester; the circular puts first-semester payable for this band at Rs 74,735 versus Rs 1,41,402 at full fee.

sources.title: Fees Circular for the New Students (UG & PG) of 2026 Batch — notes on tuition remission by family income

scholarships.name: Tuition fee exemption for SC, ST and PwD students
scholarships.eligibility: Every Indian student admitted under the SC, ST or PwD categories, in all programmes.
scholarships.benefit: No tuition fee at all; the remaining institute charges for a 2026 UG entrant come to Rs 41,402 in the first semester. Those on the Institute SC/ST scholarship are also exempt from seat rent.

sources.title: Fees Circular for the New Students (UG & PG) of 2026 Batch — SC/ST/PwD tuition exemption
Institute Fee Circular for Jul–Nov 2025 Semester — SC/ST scholarship holders exempt from seat rent

scholarships.name: Institute Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Parents' annual income up to Rs 4,50,000; offered to up to 25% of the admitted students and renewed each semester only if the previous semester's GPA is at least 5.0.
scholarships.benefit: Exemption from 67% of the tuition fee.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Scholarships Offered by the Institute)

scholarships.name: Institute Free Studentship
scholarships.eligibility: Same means test as the Merit-cum-Means scheme: parents' annual income up to Rs 4,50,000, available to up to 25% of admitted students, renewable each semester with a GPA of at least 5.0.
scholarships.benefit: Exemption from 67% of the tuition fee.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Scholarships Offered by the Institute)

scholarships.name: Institute SC/ST Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: SC/ST students whose parents' annual income does not exceed Rs 4,50,000; renewed every semester subject to a GPA of at least 5.0 in the previous semester.
scholarships.benefit: Free messing plus a pocket allowance of Rs 250 per month, on top of the tuition fee exemption; the hostel circular notes advance mess charges for these students are paid by the institute.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Institute SC/ST Scholarship)
Hostel Fees Circular for Jul–Nov 2026 Semester — note on advance mess charges for SC/ST scholarship students

scholarships.name: Institute Notional Prize
scholarships.eligibility: Awarded on JEE rank to students whose parents' annual income is within Rs 4,50,000; reaches about 7% of the admitted batch.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Institute Notional Prize)

scholarships.name: Alumni / CSR-funded Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: B.Tech and Dual Degree students; Category A covers parental income of Rs 1–5 lakh a year, Category B covers Rs 5–8 lakh subject to merit and availability of donor funds.
scholarships.benefit: Category A: Rs 66,667 a year (one-third of tuition) for up to four years, paid half each semester; Category B: up to Rs 2,00,000 a year (full tuition), subject to funds.

sources.title: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship — Office of Alumni and Corporate Relations, IIT Madras
All eligible BTech students at IIT Madras get financial aid to pursue studies, thanks to alumni and CSR partners (press release, 8 Feb 2024: 490 students in 2022-23, 495 in 2023-24, Rs 66,667 each)

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scholarship for SC students (Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment)
scholarships.eligibility: The top 10 SC entrants by JEE rank with parental income up to Rs 4.5 lakh; only B.Tech, Dual Degree and MBA students qualify.
scholarships.benefit: One-time Rs 45,000 towards a personal computer, Rs 2,200 a month for living expenses, Rs 3,000 a year for books and stationery, and reimbursement of fees.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Other Scholarships)

scholarships.name: Central Sector Scholarship for ST students (Ministry of Tribal Affairs)
scholarships.eligibility: The top 5 ST entrants by JEE rank with parental income up to Rs 6 lakh; B.Tech, Dual Degree and MBA students only; renewed on passing each year's final examination.
scholarships.benefit: One-time Rs 45,000 for a personal computer, Rs 2,200 a month living expenses, Rs 3,000 a year for books and stationery, plus fee reimbursement.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Other Scholarships)

scholarships.name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for minority communities (Ministry of Minority Affairs)
scholarships.eligibility: Students from Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist or Parsi communities with parental income up to Rs 2.5 lakh a year; 30% of awards are reserved for girls; renewed on passing each year.
scholarships.benefit: Maintenance allowance of Rs 10,000 a year for hostellers (Rs 5,000 for day scholars) plus course-fee reimbursement of up to Rs 20,000 or the actual fee, whichever is lower.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Other Scholarships)

scholarships.name: Aditya Birla Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Chosen by the Aditya Birla Group from among the institute's top 20 entrants by JEE rank; renewal follows the group's own norms.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Other Scholarships)

scholarships.name: OPJEMS (O.P. Jindal Engineering and Management Scholarship)
scholarships.eligibility: Selected from the top 20 by JEE rank in the first year; in later semesters selection is by CGPA among the top 20.
scholarships.benefit: Rs 65,000 a year for B.Tech students.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Other Scholarships)

scholarships.name: INSPIRE Scholarship (Department of Science and Technology)
scholarships.eligibility: All students admitted to the five-year BS-MS Dual Degree programmes.
scholarships.benefit: Rs 80,000 per student per year for the five years of the programme.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Other Scholarships)

scholarships.name: Scholarship for single girl child (Ministry of Education)
scholarships.eligibility: Single girl children admitted to the institute, as per Government of India norms.

sources.title: Scholarships and Financial Assistance — IIT Madras (Other Scholarships)

scholarships.name: Education loans (PM-Vidyalaxmi / Vidyalakshmi scheme)
scholarships.eligibility: Students who still have a tuition balance after remission and who meet the scheme's criteria; loan payments are reported through the institute's fee portal.
scholarships.benefit: Bank education loan for the payable tuition portion; the 2025 circular calls the Vidyalakshmi tuition loan interest-free, and the 2026 circular points entrants to the PM-Vidyalaxmi portal.
